dialog.title: Share “{{name}}”
dialog.description: Create a link to this view for people outside the base.
dialog.descriptionForm: Create a link so people can fill in this form.
dialog.manageAll: All share links of this base
dialog.descriptionDashboard: Create a link to this dashboard for people outside the base.

audience.orgHint: They sign in with their account in the organization.
audience.publicHint: No sign-in needed. Anyone who gets the link can open it.
audience.publicDisabled: Your organization does not allow public links. An organization admin can change this in the organization settings.
audience.publicFormsOnly: Your organization only allows public links for forms.

password.label: Password
password.hintNew: At least {{min}} characters. Share it separately from the link.
password.hintKeep: A password is set. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one.
password.requireHint: After 5 wrong tries, that visitor waits 15 minutes

expiry.label: Expires on
expiry.hint: In your time zone. The link stops working after this moment.
expiry.past: Pick a moment in the future.
expiry.enableHint: The link turns off by itself after this moment

settings.showRecordDetail: Open a record to see all its fields
settings.allowCopyHint: Viewers can copy the values of cells
settings.allowSearchHint: Viewers can search the shared records
settings.allowViewerFilterSortHint: Narrower only: the view's filter always applies
settings.showRecordDetailHint: Viewers can open a record to see every shared field
settings.allowDownloadHint: People with the link download the original files of attachments.
settings.allowExportHint: People with the link download every record of the view as a file
settings.allowExportDashboardHint: People with the link download the numbers of each widget, and charts as images
settings.allowExportNoRight: You cannot download data of this base yourself, so people with the link cannot either.
settings.allowFilterControlsHint: Viewers change the dashboard filters, only for themselves
settings.tvModeHint: Viewers can show the dashboard full screen
settings.refreshHint: The page reads the numbers again while it is open and visible.

scope.title: What people outside will see
scope.loading: Checking what the link would show…
scope.view_one: People with the link will see {{records}} and {{count, number}} field:
scope.view_other: People with the link will see {{records}} and {{count, number}} fields:
scope.form_one: People can create records filling in this field:
scope.form_other: People can create records filling in these {{count, number}} fields:
scope.noFields: No field is visible through this link.
scope.note: The view's filter always applies and viewers cannot remove it. Records and fields you can see later are shared too, as long as the link works; it stops working as soon as you lose access to this view.
scope.acknowledge: I understand who will be able to see this data
scope.linkTitles: Link fields show the titles of records of another table: {{fields}}.
scope.noteForm: Questions you add to the form later are asked too, as long as the link works; it stops working as soon as you lose access to this view.
scope.acknowledgeForm: I understand who will be able to fill in this form

files.downloadable: Files anyone with the link can download:
files.viewOnly: Thumbnails only (you cannot download these yourself):
files.thumbnailsOnly_one: The file field shows thumbnails only: its files cannot be downloaded.
files.thumbnailsOnly_other: The {{count, number}} file fields show thumbnails only: their files cannot be downloaded.
files.none: This link shows no file field: there is nothing to download.

scope.exportRows: Anyone with the link can download all {{records}} as a CSV or Excel file.
scope.dashboard_one: People with the link will see numbers computed with your permissions on {{count, number}} widget.
scope.dashboard_other: People with the link will see numbers computed with your permissions on {{count, number}} widgets.
scope.exportWidgets: Anyone with the link can download the numbers of each widget as CSV.
scope.noteDashboard: The numbers follow what you can read now, including widgets added later, as long as the link works; it stops working as soon as you lose access to this dashboard. Charts and numbers never show the records behind them, but a table widget listing records shows those rows, with the fields you can read.

link.heading: Link
link.label: Link address
link.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it yourself.
link.once: For your security the full link is shown only this once. Later you will only see its beginning; to get a link to copy again, create a new one.
link.hidden: The full link was shown only when it was created. Create a new link to get an address you can copy; the current one then stops working.
link.blocked: This public link does not work: the organization no longer allows public links here. Switch it to people in the organization, or revoke it.
link.expired: This link has expired. Set a later expiry date, or remove it, to use it again.
link.disabled: This link is turned off. Nobody can open it until you turn it on.
link.notYet: The link is created when you choose "Create link".

regenerate.title: Create a new link?
regenerate.description: The current link stops working at once. Anyone who has it will see that the link is no longer valid.
regenerate.done: New link created. Copy it now.

revoke.title: Revoke this link?
revoke.description: The link stops working for good. This cannot be undone; you can create a new link later.

settingsPage.baseSubtitle: Links to views, forms and dashboards of {{base}}.

list.label: Share links
list.selectAll: Select all links on this page
list.emptyFiltered: No share link matches these filters.

bulk.description: These links stop working for good. This cannot be undone.

policy.title: Public sharing
policy.description: Decide whether people in the organization may create links that anyone can open without signing in.
policy.allowedHint: Anyone with a public link can open it.
policy.forms_onlyHint: Public view links stop working; forms stay open to anyone.
policy.disabledHint: No public link works. Links for people in the organization keep working.
policy.impact_one: {{count, number}} public link that is turned on will be blocked. It is kept, and works again if you allow public links later.
policy.impact_other: {{count, number}} public links that are turned on will be blocked. They are kept, and work again if you allow public links later.
policy.impactNone: No link that is turned on is affected.

download.title: Let people with the link download files?
download.description: Anyone who has the link will be able to download the original files of: {{fields}}.
download.descriptionNone: The link shows no file field you can download: nothing can be downloaded for now, but file fields you can download later will be.

exportData.title: Let people with the link download the data?
exportData.descriptionView: Anyone who has the link will be able to download all {{records}} of this view as a CSV or Excel file.
exportData.descriptionDashboard: Anyone who has the link will be able to download the numbers of each widget as CSV.

embed.description: Show this link inside another website. Only the sites listed here can show it.
embed.blockedAudience: Only a link anyone can open can be embedded. Choose “Anyone with the link” on the Link tab first.
embed.blockedPassword: A link with a password cannot be embedded: the password unlock does not work inside another site. Remove the password on the Link tab first.
embed.enableHint: The sites below can show the link in a frame
embed.enableNeedsOrigin: Add at least one site below first
embed.origins: Sites that may embed the link
embed.addHint: Like https://intranet.example.com, without a path. Up to {{max, number}} sites.
embed.originInvalid: Enter the site as https://host or https://host:port, without a path.
embed.originDuplicate: This site is already in the list.
embed.originTooMany: You can list up to 20 sites.
embed.pasteHint: The full link was shown only when it was created. Paste it here to get the embed code, or create a new link.
embed.pasteInvalid: This is not the address of this link.
embed.codeHint: Paste it into the page of a listed site.
embed.endsOnSave: Saving turns embedding off: only a public link without a password can be embedded.
